name: pintag-pricing-tests
description: End-to-end regression coverage for admin.html's Smart Import price parsing (populateFormFromImport() -> _parseImportPriceText() -> currency.js's parseLegacyPriceAmount()), added after a reported "Can't find variable: parseLegacyPriceAmount" error turned out not to reproduce against main -- this suite exists so any future load-order or naming regression on that call chain is caught in CI instead of discovered live.
